statements.text: The change from March’s 9 p.m. sky to September’s 9 p.m. sky comes mainly from Earth’s revolution around the Sun.
Rotation is Earth turning on its own axis.
The change from March’s 9 p.m. sky to September’s 9 p.m. sky comes mainly from Earth’s rotation on its axis.

stem:
Aisha sketches the stars at 9 p.m. in March. In September she looks again at 9 p.m. The night sky at that same clock time has changed. She is deciding whether Earth’s rotation on its axis or Earth’s revolution around the Sun explains the month-to-month change at the same clock time.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Month-to-month change at the same clock time comes from revolution around the Sun. Rotation is spinning on Earth’s axis; it does not explain that seasonal night-sky shift at fixed clock time.
